author: blu
body: Instill Energy grants haste. It is a keyword-granting Aura (GainKeyword Haste), so it rides the existing aura-keyword bake path (grant-aura-keywords), which stamps the keyword onto the enchanted creature at attach. A summoning-sick creature with Instill Energy can attack (can-attack sees Haste); without it, a sick creature cannot. No new mechanic -- this reuses the same path as Flight/Web auras.
